name: The New Guard (teen arts leaders)
what_you_do: A cohort of teens works with TeenTix and Seattle arts groups. They learn about arts careers, give feedback from the teen view, lead skill-shares and act as a teen council.
pay_detail: Free to join. Monthly stipend, amount not stated.
deadline_text: TeenTix's Program Applications page says: Applications for 2026/27 programs are now closed! Applications for the 2027-2028 program year will open in Spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Check the TeenTix Program Applications page to see the current round. The page is teentix.org/programs/apply.
notes: The page says there is no cost to participate and all New Guardians receive monthly stipends (amount not stated). The program page's only year reference is 2025-26, and the TeenTix applications page says 2026/27 applications are closed, with the next round opening in Spring 2027. Confirm with TeenTix that New Guard runs in the next cycle. Work permit rule not stated.
